description: Sixteen knobs put out as the sixteen channels of one polyphonic cable

params.text: Sets the voltage carried by its channel of the output, over the span chosen in the menu

outputs.text: Carries each knob on a channel of its own, with as many channels as the menu is set to

notes: a knob past the channel count set in the menu is not put out, and the lamp beside it goes dark
with Faders or FadersOne placed immediately to the left, hovering over the module and pressing 1, 2 or 3 copies that fader block into the knobs, and f copies the first block
menu: Polyphonic Channels — sets how many channels the output carries, 1 to 16
Range — sets the span of every knob: -10/10V, -5/5V, -3/3V, -1/1V, 0/10V, 0/5V, 0/3V or 0/1V
